mapper.insert: INSERT INTO integration_outbox (id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload_json, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, created_at, published_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{eventType}, #{payloadJson}, #{status}, #{attempts}, #{nextAttemptAt}, #{createdAt}, #{publishedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE integration_outbox SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = #{publishedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE integration_outbox SET status = 'FAILED', next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt} WHERE id = #{id}
